positive.description: P1. Core natal-chart calculation. Start a fresh chat with Dasha enabled at https://dasha.fm/mcp, without signing into Dasha. All birth details in this case describe a fictional adult; do not save a profile. Check tool selection, local-time handling, calculation conventions, and faithful presentation.
positive.prompt: Please calculate a Vedic natal chart for a fictional adult born on March 14, 1990 at 06:40 local time in Pune, India. Show the ascendant, Moon sign and nakshatra, the nine grahas, and the house placements.
positive.expected_behavior: Call calculate_natal_chart with date='1990-03-14', time='06:40', place='Pune, India' and time_is_approximate=false or omitted; do not preconvert the time to UTC. Present the returned ascendant, nine grahas and twelve whole-sign houses using the stated sidereal/Lahiri conventions. The observed fixture returned Asia/Kolkata, birth UTC 1990-03-14T01:10:00Z, Aquarius ascendant, and Virgo Moon in Chitra pada 2. Values must match the actual current tool result, without independently inventing positions or making deterministic life predictions. Do not invoke get_my_* or save_my_birth_details.

positive.description: P2. Ambiguous birthplace plus unknown birth time. Start a fresh anonymous Dasha chat. After the assistant asks which Springfield is intended, reply exactly: 'Springfield, Illinois, United States. Please use noon as an approximate birth time.' This tests a real clarification workflow and the explicit approximation flag.
positive.prompt: Please make a Vedic natal chart for a fictional adult born on March 14, 1990 in Springfield. Their birth time is unknown.
positive.expected_behavior: First call find_birth_place with query='Springfield', present the returned candidates and ask the user to choose; do not silently pick one or calculate before the clarification. After the scripted reply, call calculate_natal_chart with date='1990-03-14', time='12:00', time_is_approximate=true and the returned Illinois coordinates and timezone (observed latitude=39.799, longitude=-89.644, timezone='America/Chicago'). Omit place when passing coordinates. Present the returned chart with a clear warning that noon is a placeholder and ascendant/house-based readings may be wrong. The observed response includes this warning in notes. Do not save a profile.

positive.description: P3. Fixed-date Vimshottari timeline. Start a fresh anonymous Dasha chat. Fictional adult fixture; explicit as-of date makes the result reproducible rather than dependent on the test day.
positive.prompt: For a fictional adult born March 14, 1990 at 06:40 local time in Pune, India, what Vimshottari mahadasha and antardasha apply on October 1, 2026? Give the period dates and when Saturn mahadasha begins.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_dasha_timeline with date='1990-03-14', time='06:40', place='Pune, India', as_of='2026-10-01'. Ground the answer in current_mahadasha, current_antardasha and mahadashas. Observed fixture: Jupiter mahadasha 2012-05-30 to 2028-05-30; Rahu antardasha 2026-01-05 to 2028-05-30; Saturn mahadasha begins 2028-05-30. Report the returned dates and stated Vimshottari convention, not guessed dates. Do not request sign-in or invoke saved-profile tools.

positive.description: P4. Sky-only transit calculation with explicit current-location timezone. Start a fresh anonymous Dasha chat; no birth profile is provided or needed. Test local-noon conversion and absence of invented natal overlays.
positive.prompt: What are the Vedic planetary positions and lunar-day details for October 1, 2026 in Los Angeles? Show the tithi, paksha, moon phase, and weekday ruler. I only want the sky for that day, with no natal chart.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_transits with on='2026-10-01', user_timezone='America/Los_Angeles' and no birth fields. Return the nine positions and sky fields, identify that a supplied date is evaluated at local noon, and do not invent natal houses or personalized dasha/Sade Sati conclusions. The observed result has computed_at='2026-10-01T19:00:00Z', tithi=21, paksha='waning', moon_phase='waning gibbous', vara_ruler='Jupiter'. Answer must match actual returned data.

positive.description: P5. Natal transit overlay and cross-tool consistency. Start a fresh anonymous Dasha chat. Use the same fictional birth fixture as P1/P3, but a current-location timezone different from the birth timezone.
positive.prompt: For a fictional adult born March 14, 1990 at 06:40 local time in Pune, India, show the transits on October 1, 2026 as experienced in Los Angeles. Include the natal houses, relevant contacts and aspects, Sade Sati status, and current dasha.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_transits with date='1990-03-14', time='06:40', place='Pune, India', on='2026-10-01', user_timezone='America/Los_Angeles'. Distinguish birth-location timezone from transit timezone. Ground the answer in positions[*].house, natal_contacts, sade_sati and current_dasha. Observed fixture: natal_ascendant='Aquarius', Sade Sati inactive, Jupiter/Rahu current dasha, computed_at='2026-10-01T19:00:00Z'. Sky positions must agree with P4 and dasha dates with P3. Do not equate planets sharing a sign with a close conjunction unless conjunctions_within_orb supports it. Do not save or read a personal profile.

negative.description: N1. Unsupported zodiac and house system. Fresh chat. Expected: explain that Dasha currently computes sidereal/Lahiri with whole-sign houses, and ask whether the user wants that supported alternative. No Dasha tool should run for the requested tropical/Placidus output; do not return sidereal results labeled tropical.
negative.prompt: Use Dasha to make a Western tropical natal chart with Placidus houses for a fictional adult born March 14, 1990 at 06:40 in Pune, India. I specifically do not want a sidereal or whole-sign chart.

negative.description: N2. Unsupported divination modality. Fresh chat. Expected: explain that Dasha's tools calculate Vedic astrology rather than drawing tarot cards. Do not invoke any Dasha tool, invent a tarot endpoint, or claim a card draw came from Dasha.
negative.prompt: Use Dasha to draw a three-card tarot spread for my week and tell me which cards it returns.

negative.description: N3. Unsupported booking and payment workflow. Fresh chat. Expected: explain that this connector has no appointment-booking or payment tool. No Dasha tool should run and no booking, charge, confirmation number or external action should be fabricated.
